title: Gender Pay Gap Persists, ILO Aims for Equality
discussion_signal: The post keeps the persistence of the gender pay gap visible in the public discussion around the 2026 International Labour Conference and links the issue to broader equality in the world of work.
linked_research_question: How do care responsibilities, occupational segregation, bargaining power, and institutional equality measures shape the durability of the gender pay gap?
limits: The public post is brief and does not provide the underlying estimates
It does not distinguish pay-gap mechanisms or identify causal effects
Institutional messaging may omit disagreement about policy instruments
